item.title: Easy Baked Apple Cinnamon Oatmeal - TheVegLife
item.description: This Baked Apple Cinnamon Oatmeal is one my new all time favorite breakfasts. It's almost a dessert and you could certainly enjoy it that way!

item.title: Easy Cheesy Garlic Biscuits Recipe (Bisquick Recipe) - TheVegLife
item.description: These Easy Cheesy Garlic Biscuits just five ingredients and utilize one of my favorite accidentally vegan ingredients...Bisquick Baking Mix!

item.title: Easy Coconut Jasmine Rice Recipe - TheVegLife
item.description: This Easy Coconut Jasmine Rice Recipe has a delicate taste and is the perfect side. The rice is made using coconut milk and topped with toasted coconut.

item.description: These Easy Everything Bagel Croutons begin with a standard loaf of white bread and some every day ingredients you probably already have in your pantry.

item.title: Mediterranean Salad with Roasted Spiced Chickpeas - TheVegLife
item.description: I love this simple, yet delicious Mediterranean Salad with Roasted Spiced Chickpeas recipe! It's so fresh and full of flavor with a homemade vinaigrette.

item.title: Easy Sauteed Cabbage Recipe (4 Ingredients) - TheVegLife
item.description: This Easy Sauteed Cabbage Recipe is a go-to recipe in our home and it takes just four simple ingredients. It's such a great side dish.

item.title: Katie's Stovetop Garlic Bread Recipe - TheVegLife

item.description: This Easy Vegetable Rice Casserole Recipe is so incredibly easy AND tasty! This one is vegetarian but you can definitely veganize it.

item.title: Vegan Pumpkin Spice Donut Holes - TheVegLife
item.description: These moist Vegan Pumpkin Spice Donut Holes coated with cinnamon sugar are the perfect fall treat. Enjoy with your favorite cup of tea!
